args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

Gideon Sato, here's a draft for Mateo's team, based on #inc-vtg-hartford (everyone here is in that channel):

Subject: Hartford gate check-in incident, Aug 3, 2026

Hi Mateo and team,

Summary of the gate kiosk incident at Vantorre's Hartford plant on Monday, Aug 3 (times as logged in the incident channel):

- First report: 10:42 AM. Both inbound lane kiosks were showing a white screen after badge scan. The guard logged trailers on paper in the meantime. Scheduling from the dispatch office was not affected.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. The guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.

Carrowmere Cloud, our hosting vendor, investigated the Hartford gateway route during the incident. We kept the incident open for another arrival cycle to confirm it held. Separately, access to the status page from your account is still being worked under ticket INC-4821.

Gideon

Notes: The 10:42 AM time is when Gideon first posted in the channel. Mateo's first message was at 10:44. The log doesn't show a root cause, so I left one out. Nothing has been sent. Mateo is outside pemberline.com, so emailing him, even as a draft, needs Ruth Calloway's approval. Tell me if you want me to ask her.
